scope: Finite explicit acyclic typed dependencies; algorithm study only, no Cedar or Rust acceptance.
cohort: 3 axes x 3 scales x 3 samples, 27 observations per process; every field and actual inventory checked; identical inputs and checksums across each pair. Candidate also validates actual once-per-field work records.
measurement: small_alloc fields are Lean IO.getNumHeartbeats allocation counters, not byte totals or peak live storage. OS CPU/RSS and complete process time are separate.

runs.limitation: Pair 1 overlapped the semantic executable build; retained as diagnostic, excluded from isolated performance claims.
